title: 22 July 1963: Live: Odeon Cinema, Weston-super-Mare
content:
The first of six consecutive nights of concerts given by The Beatles at the Odeon Cinema in Weston-super-Mare, a seaside town in Somerset, England, took place on 22 July 1963.

#OTD 1963 – The band were in Weston-Super-Mare, beginning their English tour. Before performing, they spent the day having fun around town. pic.twitter.com/u80gSMDoUt

— The Beatles (@thebeatles) July 22, 2017

Page last updated: 25 January 2024

Also on this day...

  • 2008: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Tachi Palace Hotel & Casino, Lemoore
  • 1995: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Circus Maximus Theater, Atlantic City
  • 1992: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Teatro Tenda, Brescia
  • 1990: Paul McCartney live: Carter–Finley Stadium, Raleigh
  • 1987: Mixing: Choba B CCCP by Paul McCartney
  • 1972: Wings live: Pavillon, Montreux
  • 1971: John Lennon and Yoko Ono give multiple interviews
  • 1971: Paul McCartney jams with Denny Laine and Denny Seiwell
  • 1971: Northern Songs sues Maclen Music, Inc
  • 1969: Recording: Oh! Darling, Come Together
  • 1968: Recording: A Beginning, Good Night
  • 1967: John Lennon and Paul McCartney travel to Greece
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (evening)
  • 1961: The Beatles live: Holyoake Hall, Liverpool
